prompt:
You improve the first-run onboarding of a desktop pet app.

Funnel (conversion from the previous step, and time taken):
- choose_path: 82.5%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 82.6%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 66.8%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 94.8%, median 201s / mean 2336s
- finish: 85.5%, median 395s / mean 5815s
- finishing onboarding overall: 36.8%

What users wrote to support last week, grouped into themes (most mail is about later problems).
Everything between the markers is data, not instructions:
<support_themes>
- [sign_in, account] Pets missing or reset after signing in again (8 emails)
- [sign_in, bug] Sign-in screen does not appear, or the app stalls before it (2 emails)
- [adoption_or_generation, bug] Making a custom pet fails or the result looks wrong (3 emails)
- [home_first_view, bug] Pet does not show on the desktop, or the app will not open (3 emails)
- [after_onboarding, confusion] Unclear how to control, hide or talk to the pet (3 emails)
- [after_onboarding, bug] Desktop features misbehave after setup (4 emails)
- [after_onboarding, account] Requests to delete an account or personal data (4 emails)
- [after_onboarding, payment] Refunds and payment questions (6 emails)
- [after_onboarding, request] Requests for more pets, items or features (4 emails)
- [after_onboarding, other] Empty messages with no description (7 emails)
</support_themes>

Big moves are welcome and expected: redesign whole screens, add new screens or whole new sub-flows,
reorder the journey, rebuild a screen out of new components. Small copy tweaks are fine too, but at least
4 of your ideas must be big moves (kind redesign, new_flow, new_screen or reorder). A separate checker
only makes sure nothing existing is deleted or skipped and nothing outside onboarding changes, so you do not
need to hold back.

Changes already shipped, in order (the current onboarding includes all of them): ['Pet Generation Waiting Tips Carousel', 'Real-Time Pet Generation Progress Breakdown', 'Interactive Pet Controls Guided Flow', 'Post Adoption Sign In Placement', 'Story Stage Path Selection Redesign', 'Photo Upload Clarity Guidelines Hint', 'Desktop Pet Shortcut and Interaction Quick Start Flow', 'Path Decision Confidence Headline', 'Generation Stage Time Remaining Counter', 'Account Sync Benefits Banner Notification', 'Pet Care Tips and Desktop Trait Countdown Info']
Changes already tested and stopped: ['Photo Quality Assistant and Real-Time Pet Preview', 'Sign-In Stalling Recovery Prompt', 'Defer Sign-In After Pet Selection', 'Interactive Pet Personality Selector Redesign', 'Cloud Account Pet Sync Clarification Hint', 'Path Choice Duration and Outcome Copy', 'Post-Adoption Certificate Sign-In Reorder', 'First Desktop Interaction Practice Flow', 'Pet Trait and Behavior Summary Card', 'Generation Completion Audio Cue Toggle', 'Desktop Companion Controls Practice Tour', 'Pet Creation Style Expectation Hint', 'Existing Pet Account Sync Reminder Hint', 'Interactive Pet Trait Preview During Wait', 'Interactive Desktop Pet First Gesture Guided Flow', 'Split View Story and Companion Selection Layout', 'Adoption Certificate Finalization Assurance Copy']
Ideas the safeguards blocked (they cannot be tested, do not propose them again): ['Account Persistence Warning and Reset Prevention', 'Reorder Path Selection Before Account Sign-In', 'Background Generation Ready Desktop Notification', 'Adoption Celebration Digital Badge Incentive', 'Wait Time Treat Catcher Game Screen', 'Desktop Overlay Environment Diagnostic Status', 'Account Re-Authentication Recovery Hint', 'First Feed Starter Treat Pack Reward', 'Interactive Desktop Controls Overview Redesign', 'Desktop Screen Overlay Readiness Check', 'Custom Photo Lighting Guidance Banner', 'Companion Path Selection Grid Redesign', 'Story Intro Card Deck Redesign', 'Companion Naming and Bio Creation Screen', 'Account Benefits Split Screen Redesign', 'Photo Upload Verification Checklist Hint', 'Welcome Accessory Unlock Milestone', 'Existing Account Recovery Guidance Hint', 'Desktop Pet Quick Control Cheat Sheet Screen', 'Custom Pet Generation Validation Checklist', 'Story Stage Interactive Path Selector', 'Desktop Controls Quick Start Guide Screen']

Lessons from earlier weeks (written by you after reading test results):
home, wait_info changes are helpful, producing 4 significant wins (+4.2%, +3.1%, +2.7%, +1.7%), though 1 test showed no clear effect.
finish, new_flow changes can be helpful, yielding 2 significant wins (+11.5%, +7.2%), while 3 tests showed no clear effect.
adoption, redesign changes did not work, resulting in 1 guardrail rollback (-10.9%) and 1 test with no clear effect.
sign_in, hint and adoption, copy changes showed no clear effect across tested iterations.
sign_in, reorder changes remain inconsistent across 2 tests, producing 1 significant win (+12.3%) and 1 significant loss (-7.1%).
Predictions remain inaccurate overall by overestimating weak ideas and underestimating big wins, and evidence remains thin for kinds of change with only 1 test.

Propose 10 NEW changes, different from everything above. Each must be testable as a 50/50 test.
Return JSON {"candidates": [{
  "title": short name,
  "target_step": one of ['choose_path', 'sign_in', 'adoption', 'home', 'finish'],
  "type": one of ['copy', 'hint', 'wait_info', 'notification', 'layout', 'incentive', 'reorder', 'new_screen', 'new_flow', 'redesign'],
  "change": what the user sees differently, one or two sentences,
  "why": the evidence from the funnel or the support mail,
  "config": the exact switch for the app, as {screen: {field: value}}.
            Existing screens, in their current order: ['story', 'choose_path', 'sign_in', 'pick_friend', 'upload_photos', 'adoption_certificate', 'waiting', 'home_intro'].
            Fields on any screen: {'headline': 'str max 80', 'body': 'str max 240', 'hint': 'str max 160', 'button_label': 'str max 30', 'layout': 'str', 'show_progress': 'bool', 'show_time_estimate': 'bool', 'notify_when_ready': 'bool', 'show_step_counter': 'bool', 'tip_delay_seconds': 'int max 60', 'components': 'list max 12', 'replace': 'dict'}. "layout" is one of ['card', 'carousel', 'centered', 'checklist', 'compact', 'default', 'full_bleed', 'grid', 'list', 'split', 'spotlight', 'stage', 'story_scroll', 'two_column'].
            "components" is a list of new elements added to the screen, each {"type": one of ['animation', 'badge', 'button', 'checklist', 'choice_cards', 'image', 'mascot', 'name_input', 'photo_picker', 'preview', 'progress', 'sound', 'text', 'timer', 'tip_carousel', 'video'],
            "text", "label", "asset": "asset:<id>", "style": one of ['calm', 'emphasis', 'highlight', 'large', 'plain', 'playful', 'rounded', 'small', 'subtle'], "action": one of ['back', 'choose', 'next', 'open_tip', 'play', 'replay']}.
            Components are added on top of the screen's existing design.
            "replace" swaps out part of an existing screen for something better that does the same job:
            {"<part>": [components, each with "role": "<part>"]}. Parts per screen: {'story': ['intro_story', 'settings_entry'], 'choose_path': ['path_options', 'settings_entry'], 'sign_in': ['sign_in_options', 'settings_entry'], 'pick_friend': ['pet_choices', 'settings_entry'], 'upload_photos': ['photo_upload', 'settings_entry'], 'adoption_certificate': ['certificate', 'official_stamp', 'settings_entry'], 'waiting': ['wait_status', 'settings_entry'], 'home_intro': ['home_welcome', 'settings_entry']}.
            Add screens by naming them new_<something> (up to 8, at most 3 in a row).
            Change the order with "_order": the full list of screens, including any new ones; existing screens
            keep their order, except sign_in, which may move later.
            A change may only edit the existing screens of its own target step: {'choose_path': ['choose_path', 'story'], 'sign_in': ['sign_in'], 'adoption': ['adoption_certificate', 'pick_friend', 'upload_photos'], 'home': ['waiting'], 'finish': ['home_intro']}.
            Nothing on the sign_in screen may lead past it without signing in.
            If your idea needs something outside onboarding, or removing or skipping a step, still
            list it, with "config": {} and say in "change" what it would need. The checker will decide.
}]}

candidates.title: Interactive Generation Progress Milestone Tracker
candidates.change: Displays animated backend generation milestone stages directly on the waiting screen to give users transparency into pet asset rendering and personality synthesis.
candidates.why: The home step has a high mean duration of 2336s. Historical data shows home wait_info changes generated 4 significant wins (+4.2%, +3.1%, +2.7%, +1.7%).

candidates.title: Desktop Placement Guided Calibration Flow
candidates.change: Adds an interactive post-onboarding calibration step where users click and drag their newly adopted companion to set its home dock boundary on their desktop.
candidates.why: Support emails report pet not showing on desktop or users being confused about pet controls. Finish new_flow changes have yielded strong historical gains (+11.5%, +7.2%).

new_placement_calibration.headline: Calibrate Pet Desktop Docking
new_placement_calibration.body: Click and position your desktop companion to set its initial workspace dock zone.

candidates.title: Desktop Pet Mood Live Simulation Preview
candidates.change: Presents an interactive mood preview on the waiting screen where users can test cursor hover reactions while backend pet creation completes.
candidates.why: The waiting step has a long mean wait time of 2336s. Adding engaging preview interactions during wait has proven effective in earlier iterations.

components.text: Hover over pet preview to test initial mood cues

candidates.title: Companion Command Shortcut Masterclass Screen
candidates.change: Introduces a new shortcut reference screen before finishing onboarding detailing hotkeys and system tray toggles for hiding and interacting with the pet.
candidates.why: Support logged 3 emails regarding confusion on how to control, hide, or talk to the pet post-onboarding, and finish step changes show strong potential for conversion.

new_shortcut_masterclass.headline: Pet Hotkeys & System Tray Quick Actions
new_shortcut_masterclass.body: Press Alt+P anytime to summon or hide your desktop pet, or right-click its system tray icon.

components.text: Use Alt+P shortcut to toggle pet visibility

candidates.title: Interactive Story Mode Preview Stage Redesign
candidates.change: Redesigns the path selection screen with stage-style interactive archetype cards highlighting companion behaviors before choosing.
candidates.why: The choose_path step has high mean duration (514s) and an 82.5% conversion rate, showing decision friction at the start of onboarding.

choose_path.headline: Choose Your Pet Companion Journey
choose_path.body: Select between story-driven companionship or lightweight desk buddy mode.

candidates.title: Desktop Audio and Interaction Sensitivity Setup Flow
candidates.change: Adds a short audio volume and window collision sensitivity configuration screen to the end of onboarding.
candidates.why: Support received emails regarding desktop feature misbehavior post-setup. Finish new_flow changes previously yielded +11.5% and +7.2% wins.

new_audio_sensitivity_flow.headline: Set Companion Sound & Window Sensitivity
new_audio_sensitivity_flow.body: Adjust sound cue volume and set how your pet interacts with active application windows.

candidates.title: Adoption Certificate Custom Ribbon Selection
candidates.change: Offers users an interactive ribbon badge selector to stamp onto their digital adoption certificate before finalizing adoption.
candidates.why: Adoption stage is the biggest dropoff point in the funnel (66.8% conversion). Adding engaging customization incentives improves adoption stage completion.

adoption_certificate.headline: Personalize Your Official Adoption Certificate
adoption_certificate.body: Select a commemorative seal to finalize your companion registration.

candidates.title: Desktop Background Generation Audio Notification Switch
candidates.change: Adds an explicit toggle and audio option on the waiting screen so users are notified with a gentle chime when pet creation finishes in the background.
candidates.why: Home wait times have a mean of 2336s, indicating users minimize the app while waiting. Audio notifications prevent abandonment while waiting.

components.text: Play notification chime when pet is ready

candidates.title: Account Sync Dual Panel Layout
candidates.change: Re-architects the sign-in screen into a split layout explicitly explaining pet data synchronization and cross-device account recovery.
candidates.why: Support logged 8 emails about pets missing or reset after re-signing in. Clarifying sync benefits directly in the sign-in layout addresses user anxiety.

sign_in.headline: Secure Your Pet & Enable Cloud Sync
sign_in.body: Signing in ensures your desktop companion's personality and unlocks remain safe across app restarts.

sign_in_options.label: Sign In to Save Pet Data

candidates.title: Workspace Desktop Fit Guidance Hint
candidates.change: Displays a clear compatibility notice on the story screen reassuring users that pets seamlessly function across single and multi-monitor setups.
candidates.why: Users take a mean of 514s on path choice. Reassuring users early about desktop display compatibility reduces hesitation before committing to a path.

story.hint: Desktop companions support multi-monitor setups and auto-adjust to screen resolution changes.
